title: feat(studio): switch Vercel deployment from memory driver to Turso
body:
`InMemoryDriver` loses all data between serverless invocations on Vercel. Replace with `TursoDriver` for persistent storage via Turso cloud in the Studio serverless API.

### Changes

- **`apps/studio/api/index.ts`** — Use `TursoDriver` with env-driven config; falls back to `:memory:` for local dev
- **`apps/studio/package.json`** — Add `@objectstack/driver-turso` dependency (keep `driver-memory` for browser MSW mock)
- **`apps/studio/vercel.json`** — Add `TURSO_DATABASE_URL` and `TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN` env bindings

```ts
await kernel.use(new DriverPlugin(new TursoDriver({
    url: process.env.TURSO_DATABASE_URL ?? ':memory:',
    ...(process.env.TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN && { authToken: process.env.TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN }),
}), 'turso'));
```

When `TURSO_DATABASE_URL` is set (e.g. `libsql://my-db.turso.io`), the driver operates in remote mode via `@libsql/client`. Without it, defaults to ephemeral SQLite — no behavior change for local dev. The browser MSW mock kernel (`src/mocks/createKernel.ts`) remains unchanged on `InMemoryDriver`.
